title: Check a course against this server
intro: Download a list of what this server has installed: its Course Core version, which course SDK versions it accepts, and the visual renderers, extensions and permissions it offers. A course author can then find out, before sending you a course, whether it will install here.
howTo: Give the file to the author. They check their course with:
privacy: The file lists software versions only. It holds no learners, courses, keys or settings. The download is recorded in the audit log.
